simple.meaning: מַפָּל (mappâl) is a Hebrew word meaning “a falling off , i.e. chaff ; also something pendulous , i.e. a flap.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַפָּל (H4651) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 41:15, with occurrences in Job, Amos.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַפָּל (H4651) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַפָּל (H4651) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַפָּל (mappâl) / H4651 is traced through Job 41:15, Amos 8:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
